name: Biodiversa+ · BiodivFuture 2026–2027
status: Open · consortium and research fit required
amount: Israel’s MoEP rules list €120,000 total call contribution and a €120,000 maximum per project; national rules apply.
fit: Only a possible methods partner inside an ecology-led study of a defined novel ecosystem. Talk2Nature has no confirmed field site, validated ecological dataset, eligible Israeli host or transnational consortium; the call is not currently a standalone software-grant fit.
next_action: No application is prepared. Reconsider only with an ISF-recognized Israeli research institution, a project component in Israel, and a consortium spanning at least three participating countries and funding organisations, including at least two EU Member or Associated Countries. The mandatory five-page pre-proposal and partner budgets are due November 10 at 12:00 CET. The Biodiversa+ call page and formal PDF give November 10; the Commission portal lists November 2, so verify the conflicting date with the call secretariat. The linked gov.il national call details were not readable in this review.
application_status: Not pursued; eligible host, scientific fit and consortium unconfirmed

name: Horizon Europe · HORIZON-NATURE-2027-02-05: Cost-effective biodiversity monitoring
amount: €16 million topic budget; expected €5–6 million per project for three projects. Lump-sum RIA; this is not funding available directly to Talk2Nature.
fit: A possible future methods contribution only. The topic is anchored to one of three EU policy areas: pollinator monitoring under the Nature Restoration Regulation, soil biodiversity under the Soil Monitoring Law, or biodiversity monitoring under the Water Framework Directive. It expects operational monitoring, demonstration cases, species identification/quantification and FAIR-by-design data. Talk2Nature currently has no validated species-identification or counting capability, policy monitoring evidence, confirmed research lead or eligible consortium; it is not a stand-alone animal-communication or general software grant.
next_action: The call is scheduled to open October 13, 2026. Reassess only after the live Funding & Tenders topic is available and a qualified, eligible research consortium identifies a concrete need that Talk2Nature can meet with a tested open-source data or annotation workflow. The public information day is October 16 and brokerage event October 19; no registration or contact has been made.
application_status: Not pursued; no applicant, science lead, policy-ready method or consortium
